name: Ottar Bare-Hand
title: Northern Fisher
description: A huge, red-bearded northerner camped by the falls, forearms scarred by teeth and fins. He has never owned a rod and finds the idea of one hilarious.

greeting.first_time: Ha! Look at you, with your little stick and your string. Sit by the fire, rod-fisher. Ottar will show you how a fish is caught.
greeting.returning: The rod-fisher returns! The salmon are still leaping, if you have the hands for them.

main_menu.text: The falls roar. Ottar turns a salmon on a stick over his fire.

about_falls.text: At dawn and dusk the salmon climb the falls, leaping, leaping. A hook is no use: they don't eat on the climb. You must take them from the air. In the pool there are trout too, if you are a child with a stick.

goodbye.text: Go well. Keep your hands warm. A cold hand is a slow hand.
